messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: To make sure tamsulosin is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have ever had:
- an allergy to tamsulosin or any of its ingredients
- an allergy to sulfa drugs
- kidney problems
- liver problems
- low blood pressure (hypotension)
Also tell your doctor if you are planning to have cataract or glaucoma surgery.
Ask your doctor about prostate cancer screening before starting tamsulosin and at regular intervals afterwards.
Tamsulosin is not approved for use in women or in children.
Triplet: ["tamsulosin", "has indication for discussion", "prostate cancer screening"]

The relation 'has indication for discussion' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug's use in conjunction with the condition specified by the object entity requires medical evaluation and patient discussion.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'should inform doctor about': Patients taking the subject drug should tell their doctor about the condition or circumstance specified by the object entity.
B. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
E. 'not used to treat': The subject drug is inappropriate or contraindicated for the treatment of the condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
